svg.title: Reference inversion, negative coefficients and component intensities
svg.desc: Schematic numerical example with four bands, three components and four pixels. The plotted marker A, marker B and autofluorescence spectra form the three columns of library matrix S. SVD retains three singular values, replaces them by their reciprocals and recombines V Sigma-plus U-transpose into the prepared pseudoinverse T. Intensity correction and row-major flattening form Y from the same two-by-two image window. The explicit T times Y product gives unconstrained A_LS. Highlighted pixel p2 has coefficients (-0.2,3,1). Clipped LS gives (0,3,1), whereas NNLS jointly refits the nonnegative coefficients to (0,721/225,4/9). Their squared reconstruction errors are 0.0361 and approximately 0.00348222. Both solver choices lead to the marker A, marker B and autofluorescence component intensities. The final colored rows identify those output components without assigning pixel values. All quantities are constructed examples; displayed inverse and NNLS entries are rounded.
